_what: covex-v6-state s4: the root cause of the dashcam and single-shot collapse

root_cause.one_line: the objective scores TOUCH at harm = 0.0 while the coordinator charges each touch up to 0.67 GPU-s of the budget that serves every other request

planner_side.its_own_comment: "TOUCH keeps an existing warm state: no rebuild, so no harm" - true about REBUILD harm, and it is not the cost the coordinator charges

coordinator_side.total_this_cell: about 620 GPU-s for 1,246 touches at a 15k-token prefix, in a 1,200 s run

root_cause.shape: CLAUDE.md consistency check 7's general shape, verbatim: a comparator planning at one price while charged another. The planner chose 1,438 touches because they were FREE in its objective; the coordinator spent the budget; 12,824 budget refusals followed

the_chain_end_to_end: plan_state scores TOUCH with harm = 0.0, so TOUCH wins whenever its gain clears the margin
1,438 TOUCH chosen, 1,246 issued; the other 192 were refused and ALL 192 for budget
each issued touch is charged recall_gpu_s(whole prefix), about 620 GPU-s in total
the shared budget runs out: budget_refusal 12,824 against noc3's 0
refused work is settled on the device (coordinator.py:925 DEVICE-on-refusal)
single-shot: 88 of 357 never sent, all budget refusals, against noc3's 1
dashcam: 5,397 of 11,764 never sent against noc3's 2,021, and 1,786 on time against 6,167
robot: 92 of 132 on time against 35, because robot histories are the thing being kept warm
verdict_on_the_cell: the robot gain is BOUGHT, and the price is paid by dashcam above all. by_deadline 0.508 against v5-rules-2's 0.485 is the net of a transfer between types, not a free gain, and it must not be reported as one

the_question_that_is_still_open_and_is_m.is_the_CHARGE_itself_right: NOT ESTABLISHED, and it decides which fix is correct
the_question_that_is_still_open_and_is_m.proxy_validity: consistency check 6. `recall_gpu_s(prefix, GPU-WARM)` is StudyRH5 Part A's isolated RELOAD TTFT for a full RECALL. A touch sends TOUCH_MAX_TOKENS = 1 with uuid-only references on a prefix the M6 guard has already required to be believed GPU-warm at 0.95 or better. Charging it a full recall's TTFT is a proxy whose validity nobody has established
the_question_that_is_still_open_and_is_m.the_measurement_is_ALREADY_ON_DISK: the cell completed 1,246 touch requests, so their own t_first_token is in request.jsonl. Measured touch TTFT against the 0.24 to 0.67 s charged settles it without a new cell
the_question_that_is_still_open_and_is_m.if_measured_much_less_than_charged: a MISPRICING bug: the budget was spent on work the engine did not do, and the rung must be re-priced and rerun before any of its numbers are read
the_question_that_is_still_open_and_is_m.if_measured_is_close_to_charged: the charge is right and the OBJECTIVE is wrong: a touch genuinely costs about half a GPU-second and plan_state must price it, which is a policy change and needs a ruling, not a patch

what_must_not_happen: the touch price must not be lowered to make the dashcam number recover. That is tuning a cost until the result improves, which is the thing MARGIN_CF's never-tuned discipline exists to prevent. The price changes only if the measurement says it is wrong
recommendation: stop covex-v6-state after s5 rather than running s6 and s7. They would reproduce a configuration whose defect is now named, at about 40 minutes of GPU for no new information, and the baselines can have that time
